title: Counterfactual Situation Testing: Uncovering Discrimination under Fairness given the Difference
reasoning: The paper proposes a causal data mining framework (CST) for detecting individual discrimination in algorithmic classifiers. Its primary focus is on causal inference, legal notions of fairness, and data mining methodologies rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or specific ethical/theological systems. The brief 'Research Ethics' section describes data usage and disclosure and does not constitute a component of the paper evaluating ethics itself.
